tasks.description: Create a basic dashboard for reports. This will involve setting up the initial layout and design. The dashboard should be user-friendly and easy to navigate. Further details will be added later.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user is logged in, when they navigate to the reports section, then the dashboard is displayed.

tasks.description: Gather and define the specific details for the reporting dashboard, including the types of reports to be displayed and the layout of the dashboard. This task involves working with stakeholders to determine the requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of report types, when the report types are reviewed, then the list is complete and accurate.

tasks.description: Implement the reports on the dashboard based on the defined details. This task involves integrating the reports into the dashboard and ensuring they are functional and display correctly.
acceptance_criteria: Given a report is selected, when the report data is loaded, then the report is displayed correctly on the dashboard.
